1.why: All five are plain intransitive verbs of motion or change; only 'hesitate' is mental rather than physical, which is a thin reason.

2.why: Five -less adjectives built by perturbing one stem slot; 'spotless' is the only positive-valence member among four fault words.

3.why: narrow/hollow/fragile are physical-property words; dreary and hasty both sit outside that cluster, so the split does not resolve to one.

4.why: All five are Latinate transitive verbs at the same register; nothing separates them structurally.

5.why: grind/mill and brew/kettle are verb:instrument, knead/bread and churn/butter are verb:product; only tan:hide is verb:material acted upon.

6.why: Five two-word phrasal verbs; 'settle down' is the only one not describing physical separation or encroachment, but the contrast is weak.

7.why: spout/shelf/label/cork are all parts or fittings of a container; crate:fruit reverses the direction to container:contents.

8.why: patriot/apprentice/hermit attach positively to their term while iconoclast and arbiter act on theirs, leaving two candidates rather than one.

9.why: carpenter:workbench and baker:oven form a worker:tool pair, but that leaves three singletons (client, material, product), so the odd-one-out is not unique.

10.why: vine, steel, staircase and stone are concrete nouns; 'shade' is the only abstract second term, which is suggestive but not decisive.

11.why: sermon:congregation and anthem:nation are utterance:audience, joke:laughter and riddle:answer are utterance:response; whisper:secret is the lone manner:content pair.

12.why: Five -ous adjectives; tedious/laborious cluster and hazardous is negative, so 'ingenious' is the positive outlier, but spontaneous also resists the cluster.

13.why: Five common character adjectives at one register with no shared morphology or valence split.

14.why: Four pairs put a literary form against occasion, feature, purpose or medium; only satire:novelist pairs a form with a person.

15.why: Five un- adjectives perturbed on one stem; 'unrivaled' is the only laudatory member among four pejoratives.

16.why: stain and mess are physical residues, delay and shortage abstract lacks, silence an absence — three-way split, no clean singleton.

17.why: erosion, polish, tarnish and mildew are all processes acting on a surface; kiln is the only concrete object, a different word class for the first term.

18.why: crater:moon and pebble:beach are feature:location, but wave:shore and dune:wind are also singletons alongside the composition pair glacier:ice.

19.why: stubborn, talkative, wasteful and showy are everyday words; 'surly' is the register outlier in an otherwise plain set.

20.why: All five are legislative-register verbs; enforce/endorse look like a sound-alike distractor pair but nothing isolates one member.

21.why: usher:theater and patron:gallery are person:venue while the other three are person:object of work, leaving three candidates.

22.why: Five bare monosyllabic-to-disyllabic action verbs with no shared frame to perturb.

23.why: Three -ing adjectives are unpleasant and two (refreshing, flattering) pleasant, so the valence split does not isolate a single option.

24.why: luminous/sterile/opaque/brittle are qualities an object possesses or exhibits; insipid:flavor is the only pair naming the quality's ABSENCE.

25.why: bark, vein and resin are natural parts or exudates; mortar and knot are both imposed rather than intrinsic, so two survive.

26.why: crack, melt, shine and float are visible physical behaviours of matter; 'echo' is the only auditory verb — a clean sense-modality outlier.

27.why: pepper:sneeze, salt:preserve, vinegar:sour and honey:bee all relate a substance to an effect, use or source; lemon:fruit is the only category membership pair.

28.why: rude, stingy, lazy and greedy are moral-character faults; 'clumsy' is the only one naming a lack of ability rather than of virtue.

29.why: saddle:horse is gear and pasture:fence is boundary, while burrow:rabbit, swarm:bee and hive:honey each differ too, so no single pair stands apart.

30.why: tadpole, calf and fledgling are juvenile animals; swarm:locust is group:animal and cocoon:silk is artifact:material, leaving two outliers.
